name: graduated_coolant_ladder
description: A vertical column of 4 PRTO cells on evenly-stepped channels (and thus evenly-stepped standing temperatures) inside a shared INSL jacket -- a multi-tier coolant relay instead of one single-hop portal pair.
why: Five saves in the 2026-08-25 harvest build coolant relays this way instead of a single PRTI/PRTO hop: 3209222 has the cleanest 4-tier ladder (PRTO@355,216-223 climbing 1001C->2001C on channels 13/23, PRTO@231/291,238-244 climbing 3001C->4301C on channels 33-46); 2001108, 259948, 2396223 and 254630 all show the same graduated-hop pattern at smaller scale. None of the existing 30 modules expose a multi-tier portal ladder (portal_pair is a single hop); this generalizes the pattern the way wifi_bus_row generalized the WIFI channel bus.
source: save 3209222, PRTO ladder x231-355 y216-244 (4 cells, channels 13/23/33/43, temps 1001C/2001C/3001C/4001C in even 1000C steps)
